title: Count shipped orders
prompt: Show the number of shipped orders as shipped, by putting CASE inside SUM. Replace the ___.
starterSql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'shipped' THEN ___ ELSE 0 END) AS shipped
FROM orders;
hints: Use 1 for a match and 0 otherwise.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'shipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipped FROM orders;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'shipped' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS shipped FROM orders;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS shipped FROM orders;

title: Per-customer counts
prompt: Show each customer_id, their total orders as orders, and their shipped orders as shipped.
hints: COUNT(*) and a conditional SUM in the same query.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'shipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipped FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(*) AS shipped FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(*) AS shipped FROM orders WHERE status = 'shipped' GROUP BY customer_id;

title: Pass rate
prompt: Show each course_id and the percentage of its enrolments with a grade of at least 60, rounded to 1 decimal, as pass_pct. Missing grades count as not passed.
hints: Multiply by 100.0 and divide by COUNT(*).

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM enrolments; DELETE FROM courses; DELETE FROM students; INSERT INTO students VALUES (6, 'Femi', 9), (7, 'Gia', 9), (8, 'Hao', 10); INSERT INTO courses VALUES (5, 'Chemistry', 'Science'), (6, 'Drama', 'Arts'); INSERT INTO enrolments VALUES (11, 6, 5, 60, '2023-autumn'), (12, 6, 5, 60, '2024-spring'), (13, 7, 5, NULL, '2024-spring'), (14, 7, 6, 95, '2024-spring'); INSERT INTO enrolments VALUES (15, 8, 5, 50, '2024-spring'), (16, 8, 6, 70, '2024-spring'), (17, 6, 6, 30, '2024-spring');

solutions: SELECT course_id, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN grade >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS pass_pct FROM enrolments GROUP BY course_id;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT course_id, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN grade >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*), 1) AS pass_pct FROM enrolments GROUP BY course_id;
SELECT course_id, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN grade >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(grade), 1) AS pass_pct FROM enrolments GROUP BY course_id;

title: Wet day share
prompt: Show each city and the percentage of its readings with more than 0 mm of rain, rounded to 1 decimal, as wet_pct.
hints: Same pattern, with a different condition.
solutions: SELECT city, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rainfall_mm > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS wet_pct FROM readings GROUP BY city;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT city, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rainfall_mm > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(rainfall_mm), 1) AS wet_pct FROM readings GROUP BY city;
wrongSolutions.why: Skips missing readings in the total

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT city, SUM(CASE WHEN rainfall_mm > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wet_pct FROM readings GROUP BY city;

title: No matches still count
prompt: Show each customer_id and their pending orders as pending. Customers with none must show 0.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: SELECT customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS pending FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' GROUP BY customer_id;
SELECT customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 END) AS pending FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;
wrongSolutions.why: With no ELSE, customers with none show NULL

title: Fix the percentage
prompt: This should show the percentage of graded enrolments as graded_pct, rounded to 1 decimal, but it shows a whole number. Fix it.
starterSql:
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(grade) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS graded_pct
FROM enrolments;
hints: The integer division happens before ROUND.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM enrolments; DELETE FROM courses; DELETE FROM students; INSERT INTO students VALUES (6, 'Femi', 9), (7, 'Gia', 9), (8, 'Hao', 10); INSERT INTO courses VALUES (5, 'Chemistry', 'Science'), (6, 'Drama', 'Arts'); INSERT INTO enrolments VALUES (11, 6, 5, 60, '2023-autumn'), (12, 6, 5, 60, '2024-spring'), (13, 7, 5, NULL, '2024-spring'), (14, 7, 6, 95, '2024-spring');

solutions: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(grade) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS graded_pct FROM enrolments;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / COUNT(grade), 1) AS graded_pct FROM enrolments;
SELECT COUNT(grade) AS graded_pct FROM enrolments;

title: Stacked statuses
prompt: Show each customer_id with separate columns shipped, pending, and cancelled, each a count of that status.
hints: Write one conditional SUM per column.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: SELECT customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'shipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipped, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS shipped, COUNT(*) AS pending, COUNT(*) AS cancelled FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;
wrongSolutions.why: Counts every order in each column

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT customer_id, status, COUNT(*) AS shipped FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id, status;

title: Discounted total
prompt: For each order_id, show total units as units, and units sold with any discount above 0 as discounted_units.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units, SUM(CASE WHEN discount > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS discounted_units FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units, SUM(CASE WHEN discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discounted_units FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id;
SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units, SUM(quantity) AS discounted_units FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id;
